entry.title: Participation at MT Marathon 🇫🇮
entry.content:
The MT Marathon 2025 (↗) was a week-long machine translation research event in 🇫🇮 Helsinki (Aug 25–29, 2025), bringing together researchers, developers, and students from across Europe and beyond.

Participation was limited to 100 selected attendees, and included MT lectures, labs, keynote talks, and hands-on hacking projects advancing tools and research collaborations with European peers.

I engaged in team-oriented projects and networking with international researchers in the machine translation community.

entry.title: 1 paper presented at ACL 🇦🇹
entry.content:
Our paper “RUBRIC-MQM : Span-Level LLM-as-judge in Machine Translation For High-End Models” (↗) was presented at ACL 2025.

  • Presenting PROMPTCUE, a straightforward approach for the direct meta-evaluation of LLM-as-judge models in Machine Translation.
  • Upgrading the conventional MQM scoring system to assess DA at the span level using a detailed scoring rubric. This approach enhances correlation and is especially apt for assessing top-tier models.
  • Pinpointing major weaknesses of GEMBA-MQM and rectify them by examining fundamental prompt structures.
